title: Grilled Lamb Kebabs
description: A simple and flavorful keto recipe for lamb kebabs. Perfect for a quick summer dinner.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush lamb with olive oil and sprinkle with rosemary sprigs.
Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
